thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of stock ownership in the US from concentrated interests in the early 20th century to a more dispersed base, highlighting the intermediary role of the board of directors between shareholders and management. It emphasizes that the board's fundamental goal is to pick the right CEO and hold them accountable, rather than just driving specific shareholder value initiatives.
